cues: Burn the midnight oil: study late into the night.
Break the ice: start a conversation in an awkward moment.
Cut corners: do a job cheaply and badly.
The ball is in your court: it is now your turn to act.
Sit on the fence: refuse to take a side.
Beat about the bush: avoid coming to the point.
At the eleventh hour: at the very last moment.
And a drop in the ocean: far too little to matter.
